run_pairwise_bleu: run the scoring script with --sys flag to compute pairwise BLEU over candidate hypotheses
run_multi_ref_bleu: run the scoring script with --sys and --ref flags to compute multi-reference BLEU scores
run_intra_ref_bleu: run the scoring script with --ref flag alone to compute intra-reference pairwise and leave-one-out BLEU
run_merge_output: run the scoring script with --sys and --output flags to merge source, target, and hypothesis outputs
run_corpus_bleu: run the scoring script to compute corpus-level BLEU scores using sacrebleu with no tokenization
